utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning to everybody. For technical reasons, the session starts a bit later and I apologise to all the parties for this delay. Having said this, Mr. Registrar, could you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-95-9-A, the Prosecutor versus Blagoje Simic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. Mr. Simic, can you hear the proceedings and understand the proceedings in a language you understand? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] [No interpretation].

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I'm now going to ask the parties to introduce themselves. We'll start with the appearances for the OTP.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: Peter Kremer appearing for the Prosecution. Sebastiaan van Hooydonk is our case manager. He's with me.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. And now for the Defence, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. PANTELIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. Igor Pantelic from the Belgrade Bar Association for the Defence of Mr. Simic, and my colleague is going to introduce himself as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. My name is Peter Murphy. I'm also here to represent the accused.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. I would like to briefly recall the aim of the Status Conference. In the present case, Mr. Simic filed a notice of appeal against the Judgement rendered against him on the 17th of October, 2003. Whilst he is awaiting the judgement on appeal, Mr. Simic is currently detained at the UN detention centre here in The Hague, in the Netherlands. According to Rule 65 bis (B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of the Tribunal, a Status Conference is convened every 120 days in order to give the detained person awaiting the outcome of his or her appeal, to give that person the opportunity to raise questions related to the appeal and also related to his or her physical conditions or mental condition. The current Status Conference is taking place a few days after the 120-day delay for reasons of availability of the parties and of the courtroom. The parties have been informed of this and they indicated that they accepted this. The aim of today's Status Conference is to allow the appellant, Mr. Simic, the possibility of expressing his concerns relating to the appeal and relating to his detention. The aim is also to inform the appellant of the progress of the appeal procedure concerning him. With regard to your detention, Mr. Simic, is there anything you would like to raise about your detention or about your mental and physical condition? You have the floor. THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I have no matters to raise with regard to the UN Detention Unit or with regard to my physical condition and health.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. You may be seated. You will remember that the last Status Conference took place on the 2nd of June, 2006, after the hearings on appeal. There are no pending motions at the moment. The Appeals Chamber will issue its judgement on appeal in due course. As far as I'm concerned, there is no other issue I would like to raise, and I'm going to turn to the parties to ask them if they have any comments to make or any issues to raise. Let's start with the Office of the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: I have nothing to raise, Mr. Judge.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. And now for the Defence?

utterances.speaker: MR. MURPHY
utterances.text: We have no matters to raise. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much, Mr. Murphy. This Status Conference can therefore come to a close. It is so decided. The hearing stands adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
